item: A036 0.6.1 rows (R552): a stale custody .json.tmp is swept; a grouped figure reads as itself in the bulletin introduction
summary: Each custody settings write removes a leftover custody_settings.json.tmp older than a minute (no writer uses that name since #1796; a fresh one may belong to an older build mid-write); _fmt reads a correctly grouped string such as 1,234 as that figure instead of the absent dash.
